data.body:
AC amendment (gap-analysis: implicit_assumption): Document fixture schema and validate required fields in distribution test.

sample-bugs.json must conform to a documented schema so calibration-report.sh (cc87) and the closure check (T3) agree on the shape. Create tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/README.md documenting the required fields: ticket_id, ticket_type, tags (array with detected_by:<channel>), created_at, status, title, author, priority.

The distribution test (test-a34c-fixture-distribution.sh) must validate schema compliance on every record — not just count detected_by values. Specifically: assert that every record has ticket_id, ticket_type=='bug', and at least one tag matching detected_by:<allowed-value>.

Additional verify steps:
- test -f tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/README.md
- jq -e 'all(.[]; has("ticket_id") and .ticket_type == "bug" and (.tags | map(select(startswith("detected_by:"))) | length) >= 1)' tests/fixtures/a34c-sprint-bugs/sample-bugs.json
